reference.question: A sector has arc length \(4\pi\) and radius 5. Its area is \(k\pi\). Find the value of \(k\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Sector area from arc length

\(S=lr/2=4\pi\times 5/2=10\pi\), so \(k=10\).
